fields.options: The 13-week Cash Flow Forecast takes the payroll from the trailing mean of the last three salary months. Two inputs the books cannot supply replace or add to it: the expected monthly payroll (empty keeps the trailing mean) and dated one-off lines for known events in the horizon. Both are read on each forecast run; nothing here is written back to bexio.

fields.description: The payroll outflow of a month, in the company currency. Empty: the trailing mean of the salary accounts is used. Set: each salary run in the horizon takes this amount.
fields.label: Expected monthly payroll

fields.description: A dated amount for a known event inside the horizon: a one-off payment or receipt, in or out. A line on the as-of date or before it is not in the forecast, as a salary run on that day is not.
fields.label: Manual lines
